english_retrieval.snippet: # Former IPL chairman Lalit Modi Plans India Return After Tribunal Grants Major Relief. Lalit Modi has announced plans to return to India for the first time in nearly 14 years after securing major relief from the Appellate Tribunal under the Smugglers and Foreign Exchange Manipulators Forfeiture of Property Act in the long running 2009 IPL South Africa FEMA case. Relief for former IPL chairman Lalit Modi. The tribunal partly allowed appeals against a 2018 Enforcement Directorate order that had imposed penalties on the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), Lalit Modi, former BCCI president N Srinivasan, M P Pandove, the State Bank of India and its former chief manager A K Nazeer Khan for alleged violations of the Foreign Exchange Management Act. The Enforcement Directorate had alleged that the BCCI breached FEMA regulations by transferring funds abroad after the 2009 IPL was shifted to South Africa because of the Indian general elections.
